trans-unit.target: TEXT_KINGKW399_05507_SYSTEM_000_000<tab>Brigid can readjust your phantom weaponry attributes.
TEXT_KINGKW399_05507_BRIGID_000_001<tab>Do you seek to alter the attributes of your phantom weapon? A simple enough task, with sufficient resources.
TEXT_KINGKW399_05507_A1_000_100<tab>Readjust the attributes of your phantom weaponry.
TEXT_KINGKW399_05507_A2_000_100<tab>Learn about readjusting phantom weaponry attributes.

TEXT_KINGKW399_05507_SYSTEM_000_010<tab>The three attributes you added to your phantom weaponry can be reselected or rebalanced. As with the initial augmentation, one of these attributes will be set to a lower value than the other two.
TEXT_KINGKW399_05507_SYSTEM_000_011<tab>Once you have readjusted the values to your liking, select “Confirm” to finalize your decision.
TEXT_KINGKW399_05507_SYSTEM_000_012<tab>Resetting your weaponry's attributes will require an additional chunk of ecliptic arcanite, so consider your choices carefully.
TEXT_KINGKW399_05507_BRIGID_000_020<tab>I require a single chunk of ecliptic arcanite to facilitate the readjustment. I shall leave its procurement in your capable hands.
TEXT_KINGKW399_05507_SYSTEM_000_021<tab>Chunks of ecliptic arcanite can be obtained from Ermina in the phantom village.
TEXT_KINGKW399_05507_BRIGID_000_030<tab>I'm afraid the process is tailored specifically to phantom weaponry. Might I ask you to equip suitable armaments before beginning?
TEXT_KINGKW399_05507_BRIGID_000_040<tab>A thoroughly successful readjustment! Of course, if you wish to explore a subtly different configuration in the future, you need but ask.

TEXT_KINGKW399_05507_SYSTEM_000_106<tab>Your phantom weaponry (<var 08 E3E94509 ((<var 28 ((ClassJob)) E94501 /var>)) ((<var 08 E1E94513 ((<var 28 ((ClassJob)) E94501 /var>)) (()) /var>)) /var>) has been readjusted.
